summary: In this fiction excerpt from Book 10, a woman named Trish visits Damian at his office about a bill and a discussion draft he had not seen. After she leaves, he follows her outside and becomes emotional about their past relationship, which she ends by reaffirming their professional respect and giving him a hug before sending him back inside. Later that afternoon her ordinary work routines resume, and she pours herself a rare Irish whisky, unsure what she is celebrating.
one_line: Trish brings closure to an emotional encounter with her former partner Damian, who now works with her on a bill, and ends the day with a rare whisky.
key_facts: Trish tells Damian that she would offer to send him a copy of the discussion draft but expects it would take a week to arrive, if it ever did.
Trish suggests Damian ask the Navy man, whom she gestures toward, to get him a copy of the discussion draft.
Trish gives Damian a hug that he finds weird, because hugging is strictly west-of-the-Mississippi, and she breaks it off firmly.
The first snows are coming in and the steps are slightly icy when Trish leaves the house.
Damian follows Trish out to the road and says her name, then his arms drop and his shoulders slump.
Trish tells Damian to stop, saying his job requires that they keep their relationship on a professional level.
Trish reflects that she left Damian to come east and do something he thought of as wrong-headed, backwards and superstitious.
Trish believes Damian never recovered after she left, though she had built herself a new life in the east.
Trish says the two of them respect each other and that this is enough.
Trish gives Damian a long, soulful hug on the street, then spins him around and pushes him back toward his office.
That afternoon Trish's phone, outbound calls, email and car all work normally.
Trish pours herself a very small glass of Irish whisky so rare that it has been known to make grown men weep.
Trish normally saves the whisky for celebrations, but she cannot say what she is celebrating.
